Depending on your chosen tactics, a game can turn into a relaxed economic competition or a full-blown struggle for influence within the shopping center. Players can include up to eight players, making each game unpredictable.

Features of the game
Up to eight participants in one trading race The ability to develop several retail outlets at once Different approaches to confronting competitors Customizable winner determination conditions

Installation:
1. Unpack the archive (make sure the folder path has Latin characters only).
2. Run the game.
